title: Marlowe Rewards Share of Footwear Box Fees on Returns
content:
Marlowe Rewards members pay less, or nothing, of the shoebox fee on returned footwear. On a Returns & Exchanges return, the member share of the shoebox fee per unit follows the returning customer's Marlowe Rewards membership; it is never read on a Gift Return.

## Member share

| Returning customer | Share of the shoebox fee paid |
|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards membership in status active whose tier carries the restocking fee waiver perk, held since on or before the return's authorization date (not a Gift Return) | Nothing — no shoebox fee |
| A member whose Marlowe Rewards earning postings in the last 12 calendar months show qualifying spend of at least 1000 USD (not a Gift Return) | 0.6 of it (60 percent) |
| Anyone else, and every Gift Return | In full |

The rows are read in order: the waiver row first, then the spend row. The share multiplies the shoebox fee per unit.

## Boundaries

| Fact | Share |
|---|---|
| Qualifying spend in the last 12 calendar months of 1000.00 | 0.6 |
| Qualifying spend of 999.99 | In full |
| Waiver tier started on the authorization date | Nothing |
| Waiver tier started after the authorization date, spend 1200.00 | 0.6 |
| Gift Return, any membership | In full |

Example (hypothetical): a box amount of 10.00 for a member with 1500.00 of qualifying spend in the last 12 calendar months becomes 6.00.
